title: Creating permanent growing beds
summary: All the steps to measure, mark out, dig the pathways, amend, aerate and mulch your 75 cm permanent growing beds.

media.title: Formation maraîchage bio intensif en sol vivant - Sikasso
Podcast 21 - Utilisation de la grelinette et préparation des planches

pages.title: Introduction to growing beds
pages.text: We are going to show you how to set up **growing beds** for a **bio-intensive market garden on living soil**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Introduction aux planches de culture

pages.title: What are growing beds?
pages.text: It is a way of growing that allows you to **optimize yields** and **preserve soil life**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les planches de culture, qu’est-ce que c’est ?

pages.title: Growing beds
pages.text: **Growing beds** are **raised** strips of soil on which you will grow your vegetables.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les planches de culture

pages.title: Pathways
pages.text: The beds are separated by **pathways**, which are **sunken** and are used to walk through the plot without ever compacting the cultivated soil.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les passe-pieds

pages.title: Plot dimensions
pages.text: For the training, you need a plot of approximately **12 x 12 m**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Dimensions de la parcelle

pages.title: Layout of 10 beds
pages.text: You will lay out **10 growing beds** that are **10 m long** in this plot.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Organisation en 10 planches

pages.title: Tools needed
pages.text:
You will need the following tools:

- **A tape measure**
- **44 stakes, 40 to 50 cm long** (22 on each side for 10 beds and 11 pathways)
- **30 meters of string**
- **A spade or a hoe**
- **A pickaxe** if the soil is hard
- **A rake**
- **A broadfork** (wide fork) or a pickaxe
- **A watering can or a hose** for watering
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Outils nécessaires

pages.title: Organic materials needed
pages.text:
Also plan for the following organic materials:

- **Compost or manure**: if you have some, plan for **4 wheelbarrows per bed**.
- **Dry material**: straw, dry leaves or dry crop residues, at a rate of about **5 wheelbarrows per pathway**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Matières organiques nécessaires

pages.title: Duration and organization of the work
pages.text:
Setting up the beds is done in **7 steps**.

If all the equipment is ready, the job takes no more than **one day for 2 people**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Durée et organisation du chantier

pages.title: Step 1: Choosing and preparing your plot
pages.text: Before marking out the beds, start by choosing a suitable location and properly preparing the surface of the land.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 1 : Bien choisir et préparer sa parcelle

pages.title: Choosing the location of the plot
pages.text: Choose a plot that is **12 m long by 12 m wide**, preferably close to a **water source**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Choisir l’emplacement de la parcelle

pages.title: Leveling and moistening the soil
pages.text:
- If necessary, **level the soil surface**.
- If the soil is too dry, **water the plot thoroughly** to make the next steps easier.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Égaliser et humidifier le sol

pages.title: Step 2: Measuring the beds
pages.text: This step consists of precisely measuring the position of each bed and each pathway using the stakes.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 2 : Faire les mesures des planches

pages.title: Width of the beds and pathways
pages.text:
First you need to take the measurements required to create the beds:

- **Growing beds**: **75 cm** wide
- **Pathways**: **40 cm** wide

⚠️ **Point to watch**: You must always **start and finish with a pathway**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Largeur des planches et des passe-pieds

pages.title: Marking out the first pathway
pages.text:
1. Start at one end of the plot and drive in a **1st stake**.
2. Use a tape measure to measure **40 cm** across.
3. Drive in a **2nd stake**: this marks the boundary of the first pathway.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Délimiter le premier passe-pied

pages.title: Marking out the first bed
pages.text: Next, measure **75 cm**, corresponding to the width of the first bed, then drive in a **3rd stake**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Délimiter la première planche

pages.title: Repeating across the whole width
pages.text: Repeat these operations, alternating **bed (75 cm)** and **pathway (40 cm)** across the entire width of the plot, until you have **10 beds and 11 pathways**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Répéter sur toute la largeur

pages.title: Transferring the measurements to the other end
pages.text: Cross the plot lengthwise for **10 meters**, then measure the beds and pathways in the same way on the opposite side, driving in your **22 stakes**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Reporter les mesures à l’autre extrémité

pages.title: Step 3: Digging the pathways and raising the beds
pages.text: Once the staking is done, you will form the sunken pathways and use the soil removed to raise your growing beds.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 3 : Creuser les passe-pieds et surélever les planches

pages.title: Stretching the guide lines
pages.text:
To clearly delimit the beds and pathways and get perfectly straight lines, use a **string stretched lengthwise** between the stakes.

Stretch a string between the stakes that mark out the pathway to be dug.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Tendre les cordes de guidage

pages.title: Digging and spreading the soil
pages.text:
Dig the pathway with a **spade**, following the strings.

Distribute the soil you remove evenly **to the right and to the left** onto the adjacent beds.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Creuser et répartir la terre

pages.title: Depth of the pathways
pages.text: The pathways should be **10 to 20 cm** deep.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Profondeur des passe-pieds

pages.title: Digging all 11 pathways
pages.text: Repeat the process of staking with string and digging for all **11 pathways** of the plot.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Creuser l’ensemble des 11 passe-pieds

pages.title: Step 4: Amending the growing beds
pages.text: Now that the beds are formed, it is time to add the organic matter that will feed soil life and your future crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 4 : Amender les planches de culture

pages.title: Applying compost or manure
pages.text:
It is essential to enrich the soil and improve its texture. To do this, you can use **compost** or **manure**.

- **Quantity**: about **4 wheelbarrows of compost per bed**.
- **Application**: spread it evenly over the whole surface with a rake or by hand.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Apporter le compost ou le fumier

pages.title: Step 5: Aerating the soil and incorporating the amendment
pages.text: This step loosens the soil deeply without disturbing the soil microorganisms.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 5 : Aérer le sol et incorporer l’amendement

pages.title: Choosing the aeration tool
pages.text:
This step both **aerates the soil** and mixes the soil with the compost or manure applied in the previous step.

Soil aeration is done with a **broadfork** or a **large fork**. If you don't have one, you can use a **pickaxe**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Choix de l’outil d’aération

pages.title: Driving the tool in deeply
pages.text: Drive the tool **as deep as possible** into the soil of the bed.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Enfoncer l’outil en profondeur

pages.title: Lifting without turning the soil
pages.text:
Gently lift the soil, taking care **not to turn it over**.

⚠️ **Warning**: Be careful not to disturb the soil layers: the amendment should simply fall into the cracks created when you lift the tool.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Soulever sans retourner la terre

pages.title: Leveling the surface of the beds
pages.text: Use a **rake** to level the soil of the beds and obtain a perfectly flat seedbed.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Égaliser la surface des planches

pages.title: Step 6: Mulching the pathways
pages.text: Now protect the walkways by filling the pathways with dry organic matter.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 6 : Pailler les passe-pieds

pages.title: Filling the pathways with dry material
pages.text:
Fill the pathways with **dry organic matter**: straw, dry leaves or dry crop residues.

You need a thickness of **30 to 40 cm**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Remplir les passe-pieds de matière sèche

pages.title: Benefits of mulching the pathways
pages.text:
This straw will settle over time and as you walk on it. It plays several essential roles:

- **Limiting weeds** in the pathways
- **Retaining excess water**
- **Breaking down into compost** over time
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Les bienfaits du paillage des passe-pieds

pages.title: Step 7: Watering the plot
pages.text: The last step before starting your sowing and planting: activating soil life with a thorough watering.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Étape 7 : Arroser la parcelle

pages.title: Watering the entire plot generously
pages.text: Once you have finished preparing the beds, **water the entire plot generously** (beds and pathways).
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Arroser généreusement toute la parcelle

pages.title: Plot ready for growing
pages.text: **Congratulations!** Your plot now has **10 beds** ready for **bio-intensive market gardening on living soil**.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Parcelle prête pour la culture
